component.name: CasterSoundboard
component.summary: A soundboard for hot-keying and playing back sounds

description.p: A soundboard application for hot-keying and playing audio sound effects and music tracks during podcasts and live broadcasts.

Fixed PipeWire default source name collision on shared node names (#27), normalized XKB scan code offsets in PTT/Mute key capture (#28), prioritized key capture over active hotkeys (#28), and enhanced contrast of advanced audio settings checkboxes.
Batch import directories directly into soundboards, clone tabs, manage PTT profiles with custom names, and customize all top action bar global shortcuts.
Complete QML touch-first redesign with PipeWire/PulseAudio virtual routing, dual-monitor web remote, Push-to-Talk automation, interactive cue points, and multi-track ducking.
Added audio output device selection dropdown with dynamic routing and persistent device preferences.
